basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Product Engineer · Full-Stack Builder · Product-Minded · Ships Fast with AI · Founder
basics.summary: Full-stack builder and product-minded engineer who owns problems end to end, from customer need to shipped, AI-powered feature. At LumApps I built and shipped a production AI agent that 2x outbound conversions and is forecast to generate $1M in quarterly revenue. I found and ship products solo too (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI, zero-to-MVP in months), building AI-native with Claude and Cursor to prototype in hours and iterate on real user outcomes. MBA-trained product thinker: I write the spec, design the flow, build the thing, and stay accountable to the metric.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI features end to end, from customer problem to shipped, reliable, AI-powered product. Reports to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Own AI features end to end: from problem statement to a shipped multi-agent product on GCP. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, forecast $1M in quarterly revenue.
Shipped multi-agent orchestration (ReAct, self-reflection, tools over MCP servers) that saves reps 2 to 3 hours per day: a real user outcome, not a demo.
Built the AI Brain behind the agents: a knowledge-graph and RAG retrieval layer (Graphiti, Neo4j) that pulls the right context so outputs stay grounded and reliable.
Build AI-native and fast, prototyping in hours and iterating to production on real user outcomes with evals and instrumentation.
Work across product and engineering: write the spec, design the flow, build it, and report outcomes to C-level.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Shipped AI-powered, customer-facing products used by millions, moving fast and measuring everything.
highlights: Shipped AI-powered, customer-facing products used by 10M+ users (onboarding agent, GenAI demo system, LLM pipeline): reliable and delightful, not just novel.
Replaced $337K in vendor cost with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks: rapid, high-leverage prototyping straight to production.
Co-owned features with Product and Sales, each shipped with success metrics and feedback loops so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.
Full-stack ownership: architecture, frontend (Vue, microfrontends), and backend, plus mentoring the engineers around me.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY), the company behind Varsity Tutors; Live + AI platform fusing human expertise with generative AI for learning. Remote-first. AI Product Engineer: a full-stack builder, product-minded engineer, and customer-obsessed problem solver who thrives at the intersection of discovery, design, rapid prototyping, and shipping customer-facing features. Own problems end to end, from customer need to elegant solution to shipped, polished, reliable AI-powered experiences; do both product and engineering; move fast. AI-native culture: everyone builds and ships with generative AI; entrepreneurial velocity (prototype in hours, measure in real user outcomes); full-stack ownership; reward for contribution; using AI effectively is formally measured. Qualifications: strong engineering (front-end, back-end, full-stack, or systems); own a problem from concept through shipped solution; build software products, tools, prototypes; comfort across product and engineering (specs, workflows, building); use AI tools to accelerate development (chat-based coding assistants, automation, rapid prototyping); excellent cross-functional communication; customer-obsessed; move quickly and iterate on evidence; familiarity with cloud (any provider); comfort with data, success metrics, and signals; fast-paced iterative environments. Responsibilities: understand customer problems through data/feedback/observation; define AI-powered features (problem statements, user flows, success criteria); prototype and build end-to-end (front-end, back-end, AI logic); integrate AI thoughtfully for user value over novelty; collaborate with product/design/engineering; own quality and performance; set up measurement and feedback loops; operate like an owner.
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong fit: three-time founder (the solo-founder DNA they explicitly recruit), ships full-stack AI products end to end (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI zero-to-MVP), AI-native (builds with Claude and Cursor), product-minded (MBA, product owner, co-owns scope with PM), customer-obsessed and metric-led (instrumented launches, 'knew within a week if it moved the needle'), fast iteration, cloud (GCP/AWS). EdTech domain is new but not required. Remote-first role; candidate is Zurich-based (note time-zone overlap for a US-based company).
